Σ GATE CS Quick Formulas

GATE Marking Scheme
  • 1-Mark MCQ: +1 correct, −1/3 wrong
  • 2-Mark MCQ: +2 correct, −2/3 wrong
  • MSQ & NAT: +1/+2 correct, 0 negative
OS & COA
  • EMAT: H·T_c + (1-H)·(T_c + T_m)
  • Speedup: k·n / (k + n - 1)
  • Deadlock: Max resources without deadlock = Σ(max_i - 1) + 1
DBMS & CN
  • BCNF: Every non-trivial FD X→Y has superkey X
  • Stop & Wait Eff.: 1 / (1 + 2a), a = T_p / T_t
  • Sliding Window: W ≤ 2^k - 1 (GBN)
Algorithms & TOC
  • Master Thm: T(n) = aT(n/b) + f(n)
  • CFL Closure: Closed under Union, Concat, Kleene*; NOT Intersection/Complement
